sn42.3:1.1: atha kho yodhājīvo gāmaṇī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho yodhājīvo gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.3:1.2: sutammetaṃ bhante pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ yodhājīvānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.3:1.3: yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sarajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn42.3:1.5: alaṃ gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
sn42.3:1.7: tatiyampi kho yodhājīvo gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.3:1.8: sutammetaṃ bhante pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ yodhājīvānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.3:1.9: yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sarajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn42.3:2.2: alaṃ gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
sn42.3:2.4: yo so gāmaṇi yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tassa taṃ cittaṃ pubbe gahitaṃ dukkaṭaṃ duppaṇihitaṃ
sn42.3:2.5: ime sattā haññantu vā vajjhantu vā ucchijjantu vā vinassantaṃ vā mā vā ahesuṃ iti vāti.
sn42.3:2.6: tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti
sn42.3:2.7: so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sarajito nāma nirayo tattha upapajjati.
sn42.3:2.8: sace kho panassa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti
sn42.3:2.9: yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sarajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti. sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi.
sn42.3:2.10: micchādiṭṭhikassa kho panāhaṃ gāmaṇi purisapuggalassa dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi
sn42.3:3.1: evaṃ vutte yodhājīvo gāmaṇī parodi assūni pavattesi.
sn42.3:3.3: alaṃ gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
sn42.3:3.4: nāhaṃ bhante etaṃ rodāmi yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha.
sn42.3:3.5: api cāhaṃ bhante pubbakehi ācariyapācariyehi yodhājīvehi dīgharattaṃ nikato vañcito paluddho
sn42.3:3.6: yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sarajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
